metadata.configuration_contract: Direct configuration fields are Blackwell builder arguments except transpose_output. Configurations with split_k > 1 select FP32 workspace split-K through make_blackwell_router_launcher; allocate workspace_shape before graph capture. Separate TMA/MMA/store warp roles are rejected; whole-job ping-pong is supported.

m192_wave_routes_20261119.verification: Three changed-input graph replays with output guards; three-trial inference-v2 confirmations and matched M128/M64 controls on two GPUs; memcheck and racecheck clean

tmem_scheduling_20261120.note: 1152x768x3072 f16: paired K128, 7 stages, queue depth 2, descriptors not hoisted (K128 halves the single issuer's per-batch commit/refill/probe overhead per unit of K; 12.42 -> 11.62 us vs cuBLAS 11.01 us, NCU cold L2, two GPUs). Selected using rotated cold-L2 NCU kernel durations on two B200 GPUs; this does not replace the corpus inference-v2 timings. Hoisting sweep covered 144 paired routes; no broad hoisting change was promoted.

split_k_in_kernel_reduction_20261122.note: The fixup/resident in-kernel reduction backends remain available but route no shapes. Their selection compared NCU durations of partial + finalizer kernels against the fused kernel; NCU overstates an isolated small finalizer's cost, and inference-v2 (CUDA-graph layers) measured the 60 switched routes 15% slower (geomean), so all were returned to the workspace finalizer on 2026-11-23.

large_m_pairing_20261123.note: Large-M routes below 100% re-screened after pairing became usable in persistent shared rings (pair-major N-fast job numbering, paired phase relay in the unrolled shared ring). Kept where inference-v2 confirmed at least 1%: 12544x512x1536 87.1->98.9%, 12544x512x1024 88.5->97.0%, 12544x512x512 94.3->102.0%, 8448x2048x512, 25216x320x960, 8192x2048x512 and 12544x768x256. 100352x64x512, 12672x768x2304/3072 and 6144x1536x512 were not better in inference-v2 and keep their previous routes.

under96_pairing_20261123.note: Routes below 96% re-screened with inference-v2 directly (HEAD library, CUDA-graph layers). Seven single-CTA routes paired with the same tile (more stages, MMA queue 1-2): 768x3072x8192 +11%, 1024x1024x2048 +8-10%, 768x2304x4096 +5-8%, 2304x768x1152, 3072x768x2048, 3072x768x1152 and 1024x4096x2048 +3-6%. 61568x256x256 moves from the rolled to the unrolled paired shared ring (+9-13%). Each confirmed by two inference-v2 runs on different GPUs, both at least 2% faster; 3000-launch stress per route. Converting the other rolled paired routes to the unrolled ring was 4-20% slower and is not routed.

heuristic_cleanup_20261120.verification: 435 schedules rebuilt with identical executables for the same selections; eight replacements reconfirmed on B200 GPUs 0 and 1 with reversed load/capture order and identical-code controls; 96 FP16/BF16 checks under Compute Sanitizer, zero errors.
